name: Center Hall
provenance: UC San Diego Facilities floor plans, converted for the classroom explorer. Rooms are scaled from their official areas and fitted to the campus-map footprint. Added 205, 218 from the retained public FIS raster. New geometry is manually traced and approximately registered; existing rooms and levels are retained.

sources.publisher: UC San Diego Facilities Information System
notes: Native stitched raster; manually reviewed room labels and boundaries.
Only scheduled rooms 205 and 218 are traced from the public 2021 FIS raster. The same boundaries also carry duplicate MS labels 258 and 269; these are not additional classrooms.
Door jambs, small column recesses and curved parapet details are simplified. New geometry is approximate, not a survey.

A single similarity transformation uses controls in both wings and independent corners in three other rooms. Existing room polygons and floor elevations are retained unchanged. The L2 slab is the exact union of its original approximate outline and the source-traced 205 footprint, because the old slab omitted this upper-floor extension. This is a limited geometry supplement, not a newly surveyed whole-floor outline.
The source warns that displayed FIS plans may be out of date; later alterations cannot be excluded.
